filter.description: A Kibana Query Language (KQL) filter for the search-after mode.

size.description: Number of entities to return in search-after mode.

searchAfter.description: JSON-encoded search_after value for cursor-based pagination.

source.description: Fields to include in the response source.

fields.description: Fields to include in the response.

sort_field.description: Field to sort results by in page mode.

page.description: Page number to return (1-indexed) in page mode.

per_page.description: Number of entities per page in page mode.

filterQuery.description: An Elasticsearch query string to filter entities in page mode.

entity_types.description: Entity types to include in the results.
